transcript.text: Thinking back to that Chengdu trip in 2025—it's funny how we kept chatting about what was playing in town and where to eat.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: We ended up watching Kung Fu Panda 4, and I remember the showtime was 16:30—felt like the whole afternoon disappeared.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My cousin handled the tickets though—she picked Wanda Cinema Jinhua and bought 4 seats, so I basically just showed up.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And the order confirmation had my name on it—Zhou Jun—which was kind of annoying because I didn’t even click anything.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Lunch the next day was at Chen Mapo Tofu; Li Na made the reservation for 2025-03-26 and it was for 7 people, super loud table.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: She set it for 11:30, used her own contact name Li Na, and the phone she put down was 13845678901. Also I remember we canceled our ride later—ride ID was RIDE789012—because we just walked.
